component.name: Sele
component.summary: A focused desktop workspace for AI coding agents

description.p: Sele is a desktop AI harness for working with OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode across local projects. It brings conversations, project context, code changes, file editing, and terminal sessions together in one focused workspace.
Review changes as you work, move between projects and conversations, and keep the tools needed for agent-assisted development close at hand.

This FlatPark package repackages the official upstream build unmodified. Install and authenticate the coding-agent CLI you want to use on your host system before starting Sele. These tools are not bundled here.

The Flatpak uses host command execution and filesystem access so that coding agents, Git, shells, and developer tools installed on the computer remain fully available to Sele and its AI agents. This grants the app permission to execute arbitrary host commands and read and edit host files, beyond the Flatpak sandbox.

description.p: Added chat forking from assistant messages, redesigned the new-chat and composer experiences, introduced message send-mode controls and persistent composer drafts, and refreshed interface styling.

Added Codex account management, concurrent Git operations across projects, AI-assisted Git error recovery, drag-and-drop message attachments, improved model selection and table styling, and more reliable Windows command launching.

Added the OpenCode provider, an integrated tabbed browser, repository file navigation, project-scoped prompt drafts, persistent sidebar ordering, richer chat references and syntax highlighting, and improved AI commit and provider failure recovery.
Improved Claude reliability by filtering internal user metadata and keeping queries alive during background work, and fixed stale change metadata on rebuilt chat items.
Added app version information in settings, kept completed Codex answers visible alongside steering messages, and preserved existing staged changes when committing selected files.
Added segmented working item windows with gap-preserving paging for smoother navigation through long conversations.
Added more reliable queued Codex turn handling, paginated chat loading with bounded previews, clipboard support for unified diffs, and smarter file target resolution with Git repository detection.
Added Claude provider support, richer project metadata and directory management, and improved active-chat scrolling.
Added controls for enabling provider skills and apps.
Improved chat performance and stability with lazy and paged rendering, remote SSH container discovery, project-scoped actions, workspace terminal tabs, and local image previews.
Added remote runtime target support for SSH environments.
Added SSH environment support for working with remote projects, including environment management, host command execution, and terminal integration.

Added tool-viewed image extraction and improved generated-image filtering, while preserving streamed text through late snapshots, isolating one-shot client resources, and restoring terminal launch behavior in Flatpak.
Added chat renaming, grouping controls, reorderable pinned chats, and selection-based quoting, with faster progressive file-tree loading and refined chat item interactions.
Enhanced Copilot plan, image, and attachment rendering, improved Windows provider executable discovery, and simplified runtime selection for host-only setups.
Added interactive Copilot questions and persistent chat titles, project-scoped settings and font controls, branch deletion workflows, and refreshed chat, action, and terminal interfaces.
Added container source support and zoom controls, improved chat switching performance, refined control surfaces, and fixed recursive restart handling.
Added GitHub Copilot support, improved host path resolution, and refreshed application metadata.
Improved controls, settings, host command handling, and cross-platform packaging.
Initial public release of Sele.
